ns2:course.label: Animal Behavior
ns2:course.description: (IB 329) Introductory course emphasizing how patterns of behavior promote survival, change through evolution, and are modified by the environment. Same as ANSC 466, and ANTH 442. Prerequisite: IB 150 and MCB 150; or consent of instructor. Credit is not given for both IB 429 and ANSC 363.
